function: CSI compression, feedback, and reconstruction of dominant-eigenvector CSI in FDD massive MIMO-OFDM, trained with few collected samples via data augmentation (p. 1, 3).
system: FDD massive MIMO-OFDM: BS ULA with 32 antennas, UE ULA with 4 antennas, 1024 subcarriers, 100 MHz; 60 GHz indoor and 3.5 GHz outdoor; no RIS (p. 10).
method: Transformer compression/reconstruction network plus lightweight frequency extrapolation network, trained end to end, supervised; EGAN (Wasserstein GAN) and knowledge-driven augmentation for few-shot training (p. 5-10).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing dataset: indoor I3 (5,000 samples) and outdoor O1 (10,000 samples); training, validation and test splits drawn from the same scenario (p. 10).
test_conditions: Train on 50-450 (indoor) or 100-900 (outdoor) samples, test on 4,500 or 9,000 held-out samples of the same scenario; sweeps of feedback bits and SNR (p. 10, 13).
baselines: Learned: CsiNet+, bi-ImCsiNet, TransNet, SampleDL; ChannelGAN for augmentation. Non-learned: random vector quantization and 5G NR Type I codebook (p. 11-12).
metrics: Average generalized cosine similarity (GCS) of eigenvectors versus samples, feedback bits and SNR; FLOPs and parameters (p. 11-13).
complexity: Extrapolation network O(4 NT Ngrp Nc); Table V: IEFSF 1.40 M parameters and 23.20 M FLOPs, SampleDL 583.00 M FLOPs (p. 7, 14).
openness: none released; public DeepMIMO dataset used (p. 10)
q1_support: p. 10: "A generic ray tracing-based dataset, i.e., DeepMIMO [51], is leveraged in the simulations." DeepMIMO ray tracing, scenarios I3 and O1.
q2_support: p. 10: "validated with 50 samples and tested with 4, 500 samples" drawn from the same DeepMIMO scenario as the training samples; each scenario is trained from scratch, with no pretraining or transfer to another site.
q3_support: p. 12: "learning-based baselines: 1) CsiNet+ [9], 2) bi-ImCsiNet [15] 3) TransNet [11], and 4) SampleDL [13]" and "conventional non-learning-based CSI feedback methods, including the random vector quantization (RVQ)"; compared on average GCS.
q4_support: p. 14: "The computational complexity of all schemes with a fixed setting of feedback bits B = 256 is shown in Table V", which lists parameters and FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 10: "A generic ray tracing-based dataset, i.e., DeepMIMO [51], is leveraged in the simulations." Training and testing use this public dataset; no link to the authors' own code is given.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Area 2 because the learned method compresses and reconstructs CSI. q2 is not met although p. 13 claims "adapting to new scenarios": the few-shot training is done from scratch inside each scenario and tested on held-out samples of that scenario. Tables I-V were read from page images.
